LanguageData.AM_Assumptions: Assumptions: current diets, policies and access persist; humans consume stocks first, then animal allocation favors pasture. Seasonal pen growth uses vanilla quadrum estimates, set to zero at modeled freezing temperature. Existing standing plants are not stocks; unused daily growth is not carried over. Forecast food allocation can differ from game AI. No automatic feeding or slaughter.
LanguageData.AM_Invalidation: Recalculate after pen/door/area or food policy changes, births/deaths, migration or stock changes. Spoilage, raids, weather anomalies, feeding by handlers, digestion modifiers and future maturation are not modeled. Unpenned grazing is omitted. Estimates remain uncertain, especially when partial.
LanguageData.AM_Stale: Settings changed or snapshot absent: recalculate.
LanguageData.AM_Failed: Calculation failed; any earlier snapshot is stale and must not be used as a current forecast.
LanguageData.AM_Scan: Snapshot tick {0}; calculation {1} ms / {2} access checks (not a TPS measurement)
LanguageData.AM_NoPopulationBaseline: Birth/death scenario omitted: no existing species population to extrapolate.
